name: IMPULSE
tagline: Turns an iPhone into a smart bodycam and gives dispatchers a live, AI-annotated picture of an incident.
problem: Dispatchers juggle separate screens for radio, maps and cameras and cannot ask what just happened.
solution: The iOS app runs object detection on-device through ZETIC Melange and audio understanding, streams video over WebRTC to a command dashboard with live views and scene reconstruction.
demo_moment: Team-described: the responder walks a scene while the dispatcher sees detections and audio summaries.

why_it_stood_out.claim: Detection runs on the phone with no server round-trip.

lessons: A phone the responder already carries becomes the sensor.
